name: Sign'n'Sync
summary: Sync your hands. Master the rhythm. Welcome to Sign’n’Sync. Experience the next level of Quest hand-tracking with a unique glitch-dissolve aesthetic.   Use 4 intuitive signs to interact with a digital landscape that pulses to the beat of high-energy electronic tracks. Launching with two energetic launch tracks (128 & 140 BPM).   Controller-free, immersive, and built for the flow. More tracks and 'Club Mode' coming soon!
